From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:16:12 -0800
Subject: Model shortlist + token profile (prelim)

Hi all — attaching the preliminary model_shortlist.csv and a short run of estimates based on the MAM workbook. Highlights below (short, actionable):

Model shortlist (priority order):
1) RW-Large-8k (better long-context handling; slightly higher latency; recommended for clinical summarization)
2) RW-Medium-4k (good cost/latency tradeoff for triage hints)
3) Llama-2-13B-QLoRA (fallback for cheaper, non-sensitive batch jobs)

Context and token guidance:
- Typical prompt length: 400–2,500 tokens (patient history + notes).
- Expected output per request: 50–150 tokens.
- Median session tokens per request (prompt+resp): ~1,000 tokens; tail up to 8,200 for full-context runs.

Monthly estimates (based on Quantiva MAM projections):
- Baseline month: 1.2M user requests -> ~1.1B tokens/month
- Peak month (50% spike): ~1.65B tokens/month

Operational notes:
- Recommend prefix/KV caching for repeated patient templates to cut tokenizations ~12–18%.
- Suggest Dedicated baseline for production (pinned RW-Large-8k), with Hosted fallback for burst to control cost.

Attachments: model_shortlist.csv (contains per-model latency @100ms-95th, estimated cost per 1M tokens, quantization notes).

Will wait for Ben's checklist items then I can incorporate final notes into the PDF.

Monica
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: model_shortlist.csv (csv)]

Hi Olivia — quick checklist and next steps attached (onboard_capacity_checklist.pdf). TL;DR and decisions we need from you: 

Checklist (high level):
- Confirm preferred model variant for production (RW-Large-8k recommended).
- Select deployment mode: Dedicated baseline + Hosted burst OR Hosted only (we included cost delta).
- Provide SOC2 scope contact + any encryption/KMS requirements.
- Confirm expected cutover date window (2–3 week runway preferred).

Deliverables we attached:
- One-page model matrix (model_shortlist.csv exported to PDF)
- Onboarding capacity checklist (detailed items for infra, network, and test plan)
- Quantiva MAM annotated with chosen assumptions (Quantiva-MAM-v0.3.xlsx)

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Quantiva: confirm model and deployment mode by Mon 11/30.
2) Redwood: provide pricing delta and draft SOW within 48 hours of confirmation.
3) Setup kickoff meeting (15–30 min) to align test dataset and run one-week smoke load.

If procurement needs the model matrix as a single page for finance, tell us and we'll convert to a summary slide.

Ben
